_description: Phase 5 Tier 1 compatibility test — the ext-apps quickstart `get-time` MCP App running locally. Smallest possible real-world MCP App: a tool that returns the current time and a UI that displays it. Verifies resource fetching (resources/read) + ui/initialize handshake + tool result push path. No tools/call backchannel — the UI just displays what the host pushes. Requires the quickstart server running on http://localhost:3001/mcp and a matching MCP server entry in Settings → MCP Servers named 'quickstart'.

components.text: Resource fetched via MCP client.readResource from quickstart server on localhost:3001. Handshake, theme bridge, and tool-input push paths all exercised.
